name: store-rating-backend
description: Backend API for the Store Rating Platform

scripts.check:health: node -e "const request = require('http'); const app = require('./src/app'); const server = app.listen(0, () => { const port = server.address().port; request.get('http://127.0.0.1:' + port + '/api/health', response => { let body = ''; response.on('data', chunk => body += chunk); response.on('end', () => { console.log(response.statusCode, body); server.close(); process.exit(response.statusCode === 200 ? 0 : 1); }); }); });"
